component.name: Chiri
component.summary: Organize and sync tasks with CalDAV servers

description.p: Chiri is a task manager that syncs with CalDAV servers including Nextcloud, Fastmail, Radicale and Baikal. Organize tasks with subtasks, recurring tasks, lists and drag-and-drop reordering, or keep tasks locally.
This is a community package that downloads the official Chiri Debian build at install time and runs it unmodified.
Chiri's Launch at login switch is unavailable in this Flatpak. To start Chiri at login, add flatpak run garden.chiri.Chiri --chiri-autostart in your desktop's startup-applications settings.
